current_text: EZLM starts your model when you sign in to Windows (you can turn that off under Task Manager > Startup apps, or press **Stop server**).
problem: Wrong: Stop server only stops the server now, the startup entry stays, so the model starts again at the next sign-in. Two different actions are packed into one parenthesis.
proposed_text: EZLM starts your model when you sign in to Windows. To stop that, turn EZLM off in Task Manager > Startup apps. **Stop server** stops it until the next sign-in.
